desc:
🛒 Drive a Cart Downhill is a fast-paced, chaotic downhill cart game.

Getting to the bottom isn’t as easy as it looks. Learn the controls, build speed, take sharp turns, avoid hard landings, and try not to crash.

Race your friends, survive the obstacles, and see how fast you can make it through the city.

Every run is a chance to go faster.

CONTROLS

💻 PC
A / D - Steer
S - Brake
Space - Hop
Brake + Steer - Sharp Turn

📱 MOBILE
Left / Right - Steer
Brake Button - Brake
Jump Button - Hop
Brake + Steer - Sharp Turn

🎮 CONTROLLER
Left Stick - Steer
Left Trigger - Brake
A / Cross - Hop
Brake + Steer - Sharp Turn

👍 Like and favorite for new carts, courses, features, and updates!

badges.name: First Ride
badges.desc: Ride your first cart down the hill. Welcome to Downhill Carts!

badges.name: Made It Down!
badges.desc: Ride World 1 from the start line all the way through the finish line.

badges.name: Eruption Survivor
badges.desc: Survive a Mount Kaboom eruption: ride for 60 seconds through the falling lava rocks without crashing.

badges.name: Ocean Conqueror
badges.desc: Ride the Ocean World from the start line all the way to the finish line, Kraken and all.

badges.name: Halloween Conqueror
badges.desc: Ride Halloween Town from the start line all the way to the finish line, past the Headless Horseman, the zombie horde and the vampires.

badges.name: Jungle Conqueror
badges.desc: Ride Jungle Mayhem from the start line all the way to the finish line, past the Monkey Troop and the collapsing temple.

badges.name: Coaster Conqueror
badges.desc: Ride Roller Coaster Chaos from the start line all the way to the finish line: outrun the Runaway Coaster, ride the coasters and the circus cannon, and win the Coaster Car.
